One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC  20543 

Re:  Obduskey v.  McCarthy & Holthus LLP, et al., No. 17-1307 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent petitioner in the above-captioned matter. On behalf of all parties, I write 
to request extensions of time on the merits briefs and joint appendix in this case, as follows: 

Brief for the petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief for the respondents: 

September 10, 2018 
November 7, 2018 

Both parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, which would enable this case to 
be heard during the Court’s January 2019 sitting. If you need any additional information, 
please do not hesitate to let me know. 

We appreciate your time and assistance. 

Sincerely, 

Daniel L. Geyser
